summary: EP-WORK-CONVERGENCE (BI-650994D7). Add WorkCapsule.workItemId (nullable FK to WorkItem, ON DELETE SET NULL) so a coding capsule anchors to the single canonical WorkItem for its unit of work and capsule + case never split into two rows for one job. Additive, non-destructive; existing rows default NULL, no backfill. Migration 20260812170000_add_workcapsule_workitem_link.

fields.name: workItemId
fields.reason: Internal coordination-plane foreign key linking the capsule to its canonical WorkItem (the case anchor). Not personal or confidential data; system-set at claim/adoption time via resolve-or-create. Deleting the referenced WorkItem nulls the reference (ON DELETE SET NULL).
fields.provenance: System-set by ensureCapsuleWorkItemAnchor at capsule claim/adoption (resolve-or-create against WorkItem by sourceType/sourceId). No external or user-supplied source.
